cobblemon.species.pink_corvisquire.name: Corvislight
mawonna.species.pink_corvisquire.desc: Its pink ribbon feathers flutter as it watches over its companions.
cobblemon.species.covislight.name: Corvislight
cobblemon.species.covislight.desc: A female Corvisquire can evolve into Corvislight after personally defeating 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in battle. Use the evolution option when available. All Fairy, Flying, and wing attack moves are available from level 1.
cobblemon.species.corvisquire.mawonna_ev: Female Corvisquire can evolve into Corvislight after personally defeating 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in battle. Its normal Corviknight evolution remains available.
cobblemon.species.mawile.mawonna_evoluti: Mawile can evolve into the player version of Mawonna after personally defeating 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon in battle. This evolution never gives Mawonna (Flower / Admin).
cobblemon.species.mawonna.name: Mawonna
cobblemon.species.mawonna.desc: Evolves from Mawile after personally defeating 1,000 Dark-type Pokemon. Player version: HP 100, Atk 120, Def 120, Sp. Atk 10, Sp. Def 100, Speed 10. Futakuchi-onna lowers each opposing Pokemon's Attack and Sp. Atk by one stage on entry.
cobblemon.species.mawonna_flower.name: Mawonna (Flower / Admin)
cobblemon.species.mawonna_flower.desc: ADMIN VERSION. Available through the mawonna_flower spawn identifier only; no normal evolution leads here. Retains the original powerful stats and Futakuchi-onna lowering opposing Attack and Sp. Atk by two stages.
cobblemon.ability.futakuchionnaplayer.de: On entering battle, lowers each opposing Pokemon's Attack and Sp. Atk by one stage.
cobblemon.species.mawonnaflower.name: Mawonna (Flower / Admin)
cobblemon.species.mawonnaflower.desc: ADMIN VERSION. Available through the mawonna_flower spawn identifier only; no normal evolution leads here. Retains the original powerful stats and Futakuchi-onna lowering opposing Attack and Sp. Atk by two stages.
